adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a race condition in the pagination logic. Looking at the `next` and `previous` actions in the diff (lines 30-47), the code sets `group.set('offset', offset)` synchronously before calling `group.findMembers()` which returns a promise. If a user clicks next/previous multiple times quickly, multiple async requests will be issued. The `findMembers` method (in group.js) sets `offset` from the response (`result.meta.offset`), so a late-arriving older response could overwrite the current state with stale data. This is a real race condition bug where rapid clicking can cause overlapping requests with inconsistent state.
